'''Myish's Scythe''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Myish, Lady of the Lake]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Drakkar Lake]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Tentacle Scythe]]. 

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Vixx]] or [[Qogg]]
**[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Swift Fiercejustice]] or [[Jovial Pete]]
**[[Hooked Scythe]] from collectors [[Kapunk]] or [[Rapk]]
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Tohsedi]] or [[Seung]] or crafters [[Grif Ebonmane]], [[Kehjim]], or [[Wisseh]]
* [[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
* [[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR

**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from crafters [[Shausha]], [[Hadusi]], [[Bolereh]], [[Tehshan]], [[Sende]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Asa]], [[Soros]], or [[Derrick]]
